svg.title: A tilted saddle with positive Hessian entries
svg.desc: E(x,y)=0.4x²+1.2xy+0.4y². H=[[0.8,1.2],[1.2,0.8]], with eigenvalues 2 and -0.4. The displayed patch follows rotated coordinates u=(x+y)/sqrt(2), v=(x-y)/sqrt(2). Blue x and black y energy cuts curve upward. The red x=-y section curves downward through the stationary point. All objects are editable vectors.
